questions.title: Default Ordering of PriorityQueue
questions.description: Which class in the Java Collections Framework arranges its elements so that the element removed by poll() is always the smallest one according to natural ordering?

questions.title: Null Keys Allowed in HashMap
questions.description: How many null keys can a java.util.HashMap store at one time?
questions.Option1: Zero, because keys must never be null

questions.title: Return Value of put on a New Key
questions.description: A HashMap named map does not contain the key k. What does the expression map.put(k, v) evaluate to?

questions.title: Default Initial Capacity of HashMap
questions.description: What is the default initial capacity of a HashMap created with the no-argument constructor in Java 8?

questions.title: Checking Key Presence in a Map
questions.description: Which HashMap method reports whether a given key exists without returning its value?

questions.title: peek Versus poll in PriorityQueue
questions.description: What is the difference between peek() and poll() when called on a non-empty PriorityQueue?
questions.Option1: peek() returns and removes the head; poll() only reads the head
questions.Option2: peek() returns the head without removing it; poll() returns and removes the head
questions.Option3: Both remove the head; they differ only in return type
questions.Option4: peek() returns the last inserted element; poll() returns the first inserted element

questions.title: Iteration Order of a PriorityQueue
questions.description: A student adds several integers to a PriorityQueue and then visits them with an enhanced for loop. What is guaranteed about the order in which the loop sees the elements?
questions.Option3: Exactly the order in which they were inserted
questions.Option4: No sorted order is guaranteed; the iterator walks the internal heap structure

questions.title: Map That Preserves Insertion Order
questions.description: Which Map implementation iterates its entries in the order the keys were first inserted?

questions.title: Behavior of getOrDefault
questions.description: What does map.getOrDefault(key, def) do when the map does not contain the key?
questions.Option1: It returns def and also inserts key with the value def
questions.Option3: It returns def without modifying the map

questions.title: Autoboxing a Primitive Map Key
questions.description: Given HashMap<Integer, String> map, what happens when you call map.put(7, "seven") with the primitive int 7 as the key?
questions.Option1: Compilation error because 7 is a primitive
questions.Option2: The int 7 is automatically boxed into an Integer and used as the key
questions.Option3: A ClassCastException is thrown at runtime
questions.Option4: The key is stored as the character 7
